submittedParameters.prompt:
Precise localized anatomy edit of IMAGE1, transparent game sprite, exact 1254x1254 canvas. Image2 style only. REPLACE THE LOWER-LEG POSE; visibly change it, do not return the input pose unchanged. Keep everything above the belt identical.
Re-draw the grounded bottom-left boot about 125 pixels RIGHT and 50 pixels UP relative to image1; SAME supporting RIGHT leg extends rearward, heel raised higher, forefoot/toe pad still touching the rear ground plane. Keep the OTHER screen-right LEFT leg on screen right, lower its boot by about 100 pixels from image1 and unfold the knee toward next touchdown; it must be just above next landing, not bearing yet. Thus near RIGHT toe supports at center, free LEFT descends to its right. Do not swap legs or copy the landing pose.
The location changes are a guide for a new artist-rendered jointed pose, NOT whole-body movement, not stretching/warping. Preserve head, qin, hands, upper garment, scale, and body anchor. The large screen-left leg is RIGHT, the smaller screen-right leg is LEFT. Keep this same anatomical tracing; the RIGHT leg must bear the body's weight throughout, LEFT leg airborne. Retain short chibi thighs/shins, two complete boots and knee/ankle connection. Boot toe ALWAYS points diagonally down-left along SW travel, never screen right. No background, floor/shadow, marker, arrow, text or composite panel. Clear planted forefoot supporting character; true RGBA alpha. Output one full sprite at identical original size.
